Q: Scipy Stats ttest_1samp Hypothesis Testing For Comparing Previous Performance To Sample A: 
from scipy.stats import ttest_1samp, t as t_dist

for col in strategies:
    s    = df[col].dropna()
    n    = len(s)
    mean = s.mean()
    se   = s.std() / np.sqrt(n)          # standard error

    t_stat, p = ttest_1samp(s, popmean=0)

    # 95% CI — in daily terms, then annualize
    ci_low  = (mean - 1.96 * se) * 252
    ci_high = (mean + 1.96 * se) * 252

    sig = 'YES ✓' if p < 0.05 else 'NO ✗'

    print(f'{col}: t={t_stat:.2f}, p={p:.4f}, sig={sig}')
    print(f'  95% CI annualized: [{ci_low:.3f}, {ci_high:.3f}]')

Q: How to use charles in a system with proxy settings? A:

Your VPC is probably on a different subnet which allows bypass of the windows proxy -- which would also explain why it can't resolve the host name of the proxy (different subnet). Check your Network settings in the Virtual PC and see if you can't use a different method to connect to the network (NAT, bridged connection, etc).

Q: XSLFO: XSL Formatter - Position Watermark at Top of Page? A:

I think that the watermark that you can set is a generalisation of the watermark that's added when you are using an evaluation license, as the watermark-text option is invalid with the evaluation license, and with Antenna House Formatter Lite, the evaluation watermark takes over after 300 pages. As such, the watermark was designed to be obvious.

You could, instead, generate something that looks like a watermark using an fo:static-content. Antenna House Formatter renders the fo:region-body, fo:region-before, etc., in the sequence in which they are ordered in the fo:simple-page-master, so you can put the content of the fo:static-content under or above the body text as you wish. (See https://www.antenna.co.jp/AHF/help/en/ahf-ext.html#ext-xsl-others)

Alternatively, you could specify an SVG of the watermark as the background of either the fo:simple-page-master or fo:page-sequence. (See https://www.antenna.co.jp/AHF/help/en/ahf-ext.html#background)
